name: DeleteAgenticDBProject

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgenticDB cluster. The ID must start with pagc-. You can obtain the ID by calling the CreateDBCluster operation and setting AgenticDbType to dedicated. Regular cluster IDs that start with pc- are not supported. Usage notes: Append the following format note to the end of the description for the DBClusterId parameter: The ID must be prefixed with pagc-, and regular PolarDB cluster IDs (prefixed with pc-) are not supported by this API operation
parameters.help_zh: AgenticDB 集群 ID，必须以 pagc- 开头。通过 CreateDBCluster（AgenticDbType=dedicated）获取；普通 pc- 集群 ID 不适用。调用说明：在 DBClusterId 参数的 description 末尾追加格式说明：ID 必须以 pagc- 为前缀，普通 PolarDB 集群 ID（pc- 前缀）不适用于本 API
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can obtain the ID after creating a tenant by calling CreateAgenticDBTenant
parameters.help_zh: 归属 Tenant ID。通过 CreateAgenticDBTenant 创建租户后获取
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target project. You can obtain the ID after creating a project by calling CreateAgenticDBProject
parameters.help_zh: 目标 Project ID。通过 CreateAgenticDBProject 创建项目后获取
parameters.name: project_id
